description: This file defines an internal interface IDhtGrainDirectory and related data structures for managing distributed grain directory operations in Orleans. It includes method signatures for registering, unregistering, deleting, and looking up grain addresses, as well as supporting structures like AddressAndTag and the UnregistrationCause enum.

classes.name: AddressAndTag
classes.description: A struct representing a grain address along with a version tag, used for directory entries.

methods.name: RegisterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously registers a new grain activation, optionally with current registration info, returning its address and version tag.

methods.name: UnregisterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously unregisters a specific grain activation, providing the cause and hop count.

methods.name: UnregisterManyAsync
methods.description: Unregisters a batch of grain addresses with a specified cause and hop count.

methods.name: DeleteGrainAsync
methods.description: Removes all directory information associated with a grain ID.

methods.name: LookupAsync
methods.description: Fetches complete directory information for a grain, possibly querying remote nodes if local info is unavailable.
